objective: Verify that optional protected numeric target witnesses expose training-label mismatches that feature-only source witnesses and declared fit IDs cannot detect
numeric_target_requirement: 1D/2D finite numeric targets only; nonnumeric types remain unknown

scenarios.name: clean
scenarios.why: actual fit target sequence matches independently supplied reference sequence

scenarios.name: permuted_training_targets
scenarios.why: fit X and IDs match but paired targets were permuted; class counts, means and histogram stay unchanged

scenarios.name: single_modified_target
scenarios.why: a single training target was changed while X and fit IDs remain identical

scenarios.name: no_target_witness
scenarios.why: caller fit with no secret key, so target digest must be absent

scenarios.name: no_target_reference
scenarios.why: no independently supplied training-target reference to compare

scenarios.name: corrupted_reference_targets
scenarios.why: independent reference label values were changed; mismatch proves disagreement but not which side is accurate

baselines.name: metadata_only
baselines.description: Train/eval IDs, declared model_fit_ids and X content row digests only; label pairing unobserved

baselines.name: label_distribution
baselines.description: Class counts or aggregate target mean, which are unchanged by permutation

baselines.name: direct_source_comparator
baselines.description: Equally instrumented comparator with actual source y values can identify same mismatches; HMAC not claimed novel over it

target_security.type: HMAC-SHA256 of complete ordered numeric target batch, no raw labels or per-class hashes serialized
target_security.key_storage: secret bytes supplied separately to recorder and verifier, never stored in JSON evidence
target_security.warning: Threat model excludes a compromised/colluding recorder and source reference; no external attestation

analysis: Only source-consistency disagreement is measured, not ground truth correctness
All scenarios within one dataset share data, so 18 cases are not independent environments
No unknown real incidents, external blinded curators or preregistration
Previous witnessed-fit study used Iris, Breast Cancer and Diabetes; Wine, Digits, Linnerud are new to the fit witness experiment but not externally sourced
Negative controls without reference or HMAC must remain UNKNOWN
Classification target permutations preserve class counts; histograms cannot identify row-label pairing
No model repair, training initiated by the observer, or automatic policy decisions
